role: A risk interpretation of the already proved information deficit, not an independent principal novelty claim.

scope.model: Exactly the known fixed finite-dimensional Schur linear experiment: full-column fixed Gaussian factor G; 0!=B in range(G); known initialized full-state prefix; complete retained states; one scalar full-clock rate-r/2 healthy path under each hypothesis with free level; deterministic calendar selected before noise; repeatable known exact-k transitions in both directions.
scope.missTolerance: Fixed epsilon_m in (0,1); 0<alpha<1-epsilon_m, then alpha decreases to zero.
scope.endpoint: Smallest planned integer post-prefix horizon at which a selected calendar/test meets uniform size<=alpha and power>=1-epsilon_m; not a random stopping time.
scope.oracle: Ideal healthy-subtracted complete white record, not composite full-record information.
scope.controllerFamily: Joint result only for the existing compact common-SPD family with common force/noise/path/clock/prefix and bounded k(K).
exclusions: No adaptive calendars, unknown onset or covariance/model uncertainty
No nonlinear D2 certificate asymptotic extrapolation beyond H<=600/f<=0.045
No new prior-art retrieval or resolution of the four full-text gaps

definitions.H_or: min integer H>=1 such that O_H>=Lambda_alpha
definitions.H_diag: min integer H>=1 with an actual legal pi and test satisfying the two uniform error budgets
definitions.H_joint: Same existential endpoint, also permitting a known K from the existing compact family to be chosen before data

results.zero: 0<=H_diag-H_or=O(1), without Theta(1) or a positive universal lower constant
results.joint: H_joint-H_or=(2 inf_K C(K)/(F eta^2))*sqrt(H_or)+o(sqrt(H_or)); infimum need not be attained
results.riskScale: Lambda_alpha~log(1/alpha), H_or~(6log(1/alpha)/(F eta^2))^(1/3); positive endpoint excess has order (log(1/alpha))^(1/6)

derivation.argument: For each actual calendar, existing Gaussian interface gives feasibility iff G(pi)>=Lambda. Projection contraction with z=0 gives G(pi)<=O_H, excluding all H<H_or. Equality of an unattained supremum with Lambda is never used to assert existence.
n=H_or tends to infinity. O_(n-1)<Lambda<=O_n, so 0<=O_n-Lambda<(F/2)(rho0+eta*n)^2=O(n^2).
Exact cubic polynomial implies O_(n+h)-O_n=B_or*n^2*h+O_M(n^2) uniformly for 0<=h<=M*sqrt(n); fixed integer L improves remainder to O_L(n).
e_n=sup_(H>=n)|D*_H/H^(5/2)-C| tends to zero. For every integer n<=H<=n+floor((C/B_or-delta)*sqrt(n)), G*_H-Lambda<=-B_or*delta*n^(5/2)+e_n*n^(5/2)+O(n^2)<0. No monotonicity is assumed.

At H=n+ceil((C/B_or+delta)*sqrt(n)), the explicit xi* calendar has D(pi)<=C H^(5/2)+M H^2 and hence G(pi)-Lambda>=B_or*delta*n^(5/2)+O_delta(n^2)>0. This produces a genuine test and nonempty feasible endpoint set.
Use actual profile-aware calendar D(pi)<=M0 H^2. Select fixed integer L with B_or L>M0. Then G_(n+L)(pi)-Lambda>=(B_or L-M0)n^2+O_L(n)>0, giving excess<=L; oracle gives nonnegative excess.

Existing family uniform convergence supplies a common H-tail and C_inf>0, excluding all earlier H across K. For fixed delta choose fixed K_delta with C(K_delta)<C_inf+B_or delta/2 and its explicit calendar, yielding strict positive margin at the proposed upper endpoint. Take alpha limit then delta to zero; no min or continuity of k assumed.

For normal tail I(t), I<=phi(t)/t. Integration by parts gives I=phi/t-int phi/u^2>=phi/t-I/t^2, so t phi/(t^2+1)<=I<=phi/t. Taking logs at t=z_(1-alpha) gives log(1/alpha)=t^2/2+log t+O(1)~t^2/2; fixed miss quantile adds only O(t) to Lambda.

integerRoundingCounterexampleToOverstren.target: Only the stronger universal positive constant/Theta(1) excess, not the proposed O(1) corollary.
integerRoundingCounterexampleToOverstren.existingAllowedPlant: A_K=[[0,1/2],[0,0]], G=B=e2, n0=1, rho0=0, eta=1, r=1/100, k=1, both missing profiles g=0.
integerRoundingCounterexampleToOverstren.projection: H2=[e1/2,e2]; P2=I2, beta1=0. The calendar repeats +1,0,-1,0 and replaces a final missing slot by continued holding if H even; every actual interval has length<=2, so P=I on all inputs.
integerRoundingCounterexampleToOverstren.completeClockBounds: Prefix g0=1. |S_t|<=3; Abel gives |N|<=6H, D>=H/2, |N/D|<=12. Repaired scalar mass is zero and partial masses <=18(t+1).
integerRoundingCounterexampleToOverstren.riskSequence: Lambda_H=O_H-H^2/4=H^3/6+H/12; alpha_H=1-Phi(sqrt(2Lambda_H)-z_(1-epsilon_m)); alpha_H tends down to 0. O_(H-1)<Lambda_H<O_H and an actual calendar has G>Lambda_H, so H_diag(alpha_H)=H_or(alpha_H)=H.
integerRoundingCounterexampleToOverstren.notPhysicalParameterRescue: An exact same-model illustration using the previously admitted copy plant, unrelated to changing any frozen nonlinear experiment.
